content.text: /ext:medcp What is the most frequent diagnosis among women in their 50s in our cohort?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT 
    c.concept_name AS diagnosis,
    COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count,
    COUNT(*) AS condition_occurrences
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
JOIN omop.person p ON co.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE p.gender_concept_id = 8532
  AND p.birth_year BETWEEN 1967 AND 1976
GROUP BY c.concept_name
ORDER BY patient_count DESC
LIMIT 15;

The previous query used years 1970–1979 (ages ~46–56 today). Let me refine to women aged **50–59** (born **1967–1976**), which is the standard "50s" definition:

arguments.sql_query:

    c.concept_name AS diagnosis,
    COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count,
    COUNT(*) AS condition_occurrences
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
JOIN omop.person p ON co.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE p.gender_concept_id = 8532
  AND YEAR(p.birth_datetime) BETWEEN 1967 AND 1976
GROUP BY c.concept_name
ORDER BY patient_count DESC;
